name: crosspad
description: CrossPad development toolkit: the crosspad-mcp server plus three Claude Code skills — `crosspad` (onboarding/help: ecosystem map, install & config, per-role guides, tool cheat-sheet, FAQ — use this first), `swd-tracer` (real-time SWD variable tracing for CrossPad r20 / STM32G0B1 firmware over ST-Link) and `before-after` (prove a change did or did not move the UI or cost frames: per-app simulator screenshots plus an LVGL_STATS benchmark on the board).
